resources.string: One room: whatever is copied on any of them, the others see
A device that is offline gets the clipboard when it is back. Another phone joins by scanning the QR of tossling pair on any Mac in the room.
Every device in the room sees this name.
This name is shown on this phone only. Leave it empty to go back to the device\'s own name.
The phone removes the room key and stops getting the clipboard. Come back with tossling pair.
The device loses access to the room: the others move to a new key. Everyone else keeps working.
The encryption key will be removed from the phone. To share the clipboard again you will have to pair once more.
The new Mac joins the room and sees the shared clipboard
On a Mac that is already in the room, run
On the new one, run the command it shows

or scan the QR of the new Mac
The room was created on this Mac, so it can\'t be removed from the room. If you no longer want its clipboard, leave the room on the main screen.
This Mac created the room and can\'t be removed. The phone removes the room key and stops getting the clipboard from every device in it.
